description: Signal Engine RAG evaluation dataset (Task 8.6). Small, hand-authored, checked-in. Independent of any production database and of external web access. Passage ids are synthetic and belong only to this fixture — they are not real indexed passage ids. Grades follow the Task 8.3A convention: 2 = directly relevant, 1 = partially relevant. 'answerable' is whether a correct system answers the query from this corpus rather than abstaining. Extend by appending a judgement object.

judgements.query: How much is Acme paying to acquire Beta?
When is the Acme and Beta deal expected to close?
Which regulator approved the transatlantic data transfer framework?
What penalties does the new automated-decision rule impose for non-compliance?
Who is the chief executive of Acme Corp?
